title: Update Community Map to a Google Earth-like 3D globe with member location pins

requirements.text: Replace the current 2D world map in `frontend/src/components/community/CommunityMapPanel.tsx` with an interactive Google Earth-like 3D globe that supports rotate and zoom, while keeping the existing Community Map page framework (page layout, member directory, and selected-member details card behavior) intact.

quotes: now change the community map page. I like the framework of it but the map itself is not right . i want it to be similart to a google earth map with pins where each user lives

acceptanceCriteria: The Community Map page route (`/community-map`) remains the same and continues to render the existing header, member directory cards, and stats panel.
The map area is rendered as a 3D globe (Earth-like) instead of the current flat image `/assets/generated/world-map.dim_1600x900.png`.
Users can rotate the globe (drag) and zoom in/out (mouse wheel / trackpad), producing a Google Earth-like interaction feel.
The existing member selection UX is preserved: selecting a member on the map highlights them and shows the selected-member details card overlay; clicking the X clears selection.
Clicking a member card in the directory still selects the same member on the globe and brings the user back to the map area (current scroll-to-top behavior is preserved).

requirements.text: Render a pin/marker on the globe for each community member returned by `getCommunityMapProfiles()` that has `coordinates`, positioning markers using latitude/longitude on the sphere surface, and allow selecting members by clicking their pin.

quotes: i want it to be similart to a google earth map with pins where each user lives

acceptanceCriteria: For every `CommunityMapProfile` with non-null `coordinates`, a visible pin/marker is shown on the globe at the correct approximate location.
Clicking a pin selects/deselects the corresponding member (toggle behavior consistent with current map marker behavior).
Selected member pin/marker has a clearly distinct visual state (e.g., scale/ring/brightness) compared to unselected pins.
Pins are not rendered for profiles where `coordinates` is null/undefined.
No external map services (Google Maps/Earth APIs) are required for the map to function.

requirements.text: Use new static Earth texture asset(s) for the globe surface and load them from `frontend/public/assets/generated` (do not fetch textures through the backend).

quotes: i want it to be similart to a google earth map

acceptanceCriteria: The globe surface uses the provided generated Earth texture asset(s) located under `frontend/public/assets/generated`.
All texture URLs are local static asset paths (e.g., `/assets/generated/...`) and load correctly in production builds.
The previous 2D map image is no longer required for the main globe rendering path.

requirements.text: Add a graceful fallback UI if the user’s environment cannot render the 3D globe (e.g., WebGL not available), using an English user-facing message within the map card area.

quotes: the map itself is not right

acceptanceCriteria: If 3D rendering cannot initialize, the map panel shows a clear English message indicating the interactive globe is unavailable on the device/browser.
The rest of the Community Map page (member directory and stats) remains usable even if the globe cannot render.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and `frontend/src/components/ui/**`) must not be edited.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (`backend/main.mo`).
Do not integrate or depend on Google Earth/Google Maps APIs or any third-party map provider.
nonGoals: Collecting or inferring member location automatically (GPS/geolocation).
Real-time presence or live location updates.

required: High-resolution equirectangular Earth day texture, realistic satellite-style (earth-day-texture.dim_2048x1024.jpg)
